class.name: gimbalrotor_remote/ArmControlPanel
class.description: Turn the servo torque of the gimbalrotor arm joints on and off through the services of gimbalrotor/arm_torque_server.py, and move the joints through the FollowJointTrajectory action of the arm controller.

class.name: gimbalrotor_remote/FlightTeleopPanel
class.description: Basic teleoperation of an aerial robot (arming, takeoff, land, halt and velocity commands), equivalent to aerial_robot_base/keyboard_command.py.
